title: PULSE FOUNDRY
tagline: Draw the pulse. Shape the bass. Light up the room.
help: Tap the sixteen-step grid: K kick, S snare, H hat, C pitched chime. Your pattern develops through a sixteen-bar arrangement with a breakdown, bass movement, melodic variations and a final return. Radiant energy adds fills. Lock Rhythm to preserve your grid when generating a new song.
seeds: The grid has 64 editable on/off cells. That is 2^64 raw patterns, including silence and patterns that may not be musically useful.
